facts.text: The hotel is at 333 Charoennakorn Road, Klongsan, Bangkok.
facts.excerpt: 333 Charoennakorn Road, Klongsan, Bangkok 10600, Thailand

facts.text: The hotel is 39 km from Suvarnabhumi Airport and 33 km from Don Muang Airport.
facts.excerpt: 39 km (24 miles), 45 minutes from Suvarnabhumi Airport / 33 km (20 miles), 30 minutes from Don Muang Airport

facts.text: Every room and suite opens to the Chao Phraya River.
facts.excerpt: Every room and suite opens to the Chao Phraya River, pairing timeless Thai design with generous space and a sense of calm above the city.

facts.text: Rooms are finished with polished teak and silks.
facts.excerpt: Polished teak, lustrous silks and panoramic Chao Phraya River views bring timeless Thai elegance to every room.

facts.text: The 36th-floor Thai Suite is designed around the concept of a traditional Thai luxury home.
facts.excerpt: The spectacular 36th floor Thai Suite is designed around the concept of a traditional Thai luxury home

facts.text: The Terrace Suite on the 37th floor has a landscaped terrace with teak decking, sun loungers, a dining area and an outdoor whirlpool.
facts.excerpt: The Terrace Suite on the 37th floor is a masterpiece in Thai sophistication. A stunning landscaped terrace is the pièce de résistance, with polished teak decking, sun loungers, an intimate dining area and the ultimate indulgence, an outdoor whirlpool.

facts.text: The Duplex Suite spans the 36th and 37th floors.
facts.excerpt: The mansion-like Duplex Suite rises spectacularly through the 36th and 37th floors

facts.text: Thiptara serves Thai cuisine overlooking the Chao Phraya River, set among traditional teakwood salas and tropical gardens.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the Chao Phraya River, Thiptara is a soulfull expression of Thai dining, framed by traditional teakwood salas and tropical gardens.

facts.text: Thiptara's menu is led by Chef Luk.
facts.excerpt: Led by Chef Luk, the menu draws on tradition and technique

facts.text: Peninsula Bangkok chefs give step-by-step Thai cooking demonstrations.
facts.excerpt: Learn the art of cooking authentic Thai cuisine as Peninsula Bangkok chefs give you step-by-step demonstrations for each dish while explaining proper processes and techniques.

facts.text: Dining includes Peninsula Afternoon Tea, Thai cuisine and riverside buffets.
facts.excerpt: From the elegance of Peninsula Afternoon Tea to authentic Thai cuisine and vibrant riverside buffets

facts.text: The hotel has a three-tiered pool with river and city views.
facts.excerpt: Guests will be pampered with an exotic three-tiered pool with breathtaking river and city views

facts.text: The pool area has traditional Thai salas for shade.
facts.excerpt: seek shade in the comfort of one of 12 traditional Thai salas with your favourite cocktail and a light snack from The Pool Bar

facts.text: The Peninsula Spa is in a three-story Thai colonial-style building by the river, with private suites that have steam showers and whirlpools overlooking the Chao Phraya River.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Spa is located in a stunning three-story Thai colonial-style building by the river, which houses a number of private suites with steam showers and an en-suite whirlpool overlooking the Chao Phraya River.

facts.text: Spa treatments draw on European, Oriental and Ayurvedic traditions.
facts.excerpt: Traditional methods from European, Oriental and Ayurvedic philosophies seamlessly combine with contemporary comforts at The Peninsula Spa.

facts.text: The spa has a sauna, steam room and plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: relax in our sauna, steam room and plunge pools

facts.text: A minimum age of 16 is required for spa access and treatments.
facts.excerpt: A minimum age of 16 is required for access and treatments.

facts.text: The hotel has a tennis court with coaching from a certified professional instructor.
facts.excerpt: Elevate your game with personalised tennis coaching sessions led by our certified professional instructor

facts.text: Pickleball sessions are instructor-led, with paddles and balls provided.
facts.excerpt: Our hotel-instructor-led pickleball sessions take place on professionally maintained courts, with paddles and balls provided for your convenience.

facts.text: The Fitness Centre has Life Fitness cardio machines.
facts.excerpt: Guests are invited to take advantage of the range of treadmills, elliptical, cycle and stair-climbing machines by Life Fitness

facts.text: The hotel offers helicopter transfers via its private helipad.
facts.excerpt: the exceptional convenience of helicopter transfers via the hotel

facts.text: The hotel's car fleet includes BMW 7 Series cars and a Mercedes-Benz van.
facts.excerpt: From the refined comfort of a fleet of BMW 7 Series or Mercedes-Benz van

facts.text: The hotel's signature Tuk Tuk and Electric Tuk Tuk offer drop-off and pick-up at ICONSIAM.
facts.excerpt: Experience Bangkok in distinctive Peninsula style aboard our signature Tuk Tuk and Electric Tuk Tuk, offering convenient drop-off and pick-up service at ICONSIAM.

facts.text: The hotel's rice-barge-inspired boats connect to the BTS Skytrain, ICONSIAM and selected public piers on request.
facts.excerpt: rice-barge-inspired vessels. These iconic vessels provide seamless connections to the BTS Skytrain, ICONSIAM and selected public piers upon request

facts.text: The Peninsula Boat is reserved exclusively for hotel guests.
facts.excerpt: Reserved exclusively for hotel guests, these beautifully crafted boats provide a refined and comfortable journey

facts.text: The hotel's Rolls-Royce Silver Spur is available for display at special events.
facts.excerpt: The iconic Rolls-Royce Silver Spur is available for display at your special events

facts.text: Guests can cruise the Chao Phraya River in a restored Peninsula rice barge.
facts.excerpt: Cruise along the Chao Phraya River in a beautifully restored Peninsula rice barge and catch a glimpse of riverside life in Bangkok.

facts.text: The hotel has been honoured with MICHELIN Keys and the Forbes Five-Star rating.
facts.excerpt: Honoured with MICHELIN Keys and the Forbes Five-Star rating

facts.text: Grand Deluxe Balcony Rooms are on the 23rd to 35th floors with views of the city and the river.
facts.excerpt: Grand Deluxe Balcony Rooms are situated on the 23rd to 35th floors of the hotel with sweeping views of the city and along the river.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a tranquil riverside retreat in the heart of the city.
facts.excerpt: The Peninsula Bangkok is a tranquil riverside retreat in the heart of the city
